gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-jp: Noto Sans JP reads tall and open, its curves sweeping wide instead of curling shut. Righteous sits above it like bent steel rod with full bowls, and the body keeps going without any strain.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Fun, loud, and a little bold. Righteous bends its letters from thin rod with full bowls, while Noto Sans Kaithi stays low-key with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Loud, rounded, a bit cheeky. Righteous is happiest announcing things with its full bowls and rod-like lines, whereas Noto Sans Kannada does its best work quietly, with gentle capitals and s curves that open wide at both ends.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Commanding up top, tidy below. Shrink Righteous too far and its full bowls crowd together, while Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away from the curve and keeps capitals only slightly above the lowercase.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, with curves that never close back on themselves. And Righteous, bent from thin rod with bowls filling the line, gives that stripe a loud, playful lead-in.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer reads clean and modern, its openings cut generously like notches in wood. Righteous brings the swagger above, yet the body's small letters stand nearly capital-sized, so paragraphs run along without tiring.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Big-eyed and bright up front. Righteous bends its rope-like strokes into bowls that fill the line, and Noto Sans Khojki follows with wide exits and a large eye on every e, so light passes right through.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Pipe-like strokes and bowls that fill the line give Righteous a loud, playful face above a quieter sans. Noto Sans Khudawadi's unlatched rounds are the real strength.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kr: Righteous locks its curves and stems into lockstep, with bowls that fill the line like bent steel rod. Noto Sans KR follows with generous gaps and a big x-height.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-lao: Righteous draws every line with a steady, marker-like weight, bowls filling the line like bent steel rod. Noto Sans Lao brings an x-height well above usual.
